references.purpose: Application, renewal, variation and revocation cases
Credential or document evidencing the grant

invariants: Activity classifiers never constitute permission, identity or scope.
Every grant and transition identifies authority and legal basis.
Authorization case state and grant state remain distinct and non-inferable.
Scope is enumerative and unlisted activity, site, asset or party is unauthorized.
Conditions are authority-sourced, typed, dated and versioned.
Suspension, expiry, revocation, annulment and surrender remain distinct.
Only an authority act changes grant state.
Transfer requires an explicit authority holder-change decision.
Relationships never extend permission to subsidiaries, affiliates, contractors or successors.
Regulatory, commercial and IP rights never substitute for one another.
Current status requires a fresh authoritative-register observation.
Credentials evidence grants but never create or own them.
Grant, scope and condition history remains append-only and citable.
Grant identifiers and versions are never recycled.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
WM-POL-014 ambiguity and jurisdiction-specific classes require adjudication.
Specialist review, frozen audit, crosswalks and immutable pins remain pending.
